wholeGoal.title: Evolutionäre Erklärungsansätze mit Genetik abgleichen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann die Aussagekraft verschiedener Erklärungsansätze zu Mechanismen der Evolution beurteilen und ihre Vereinbarkeit mit dem heutigen Wissensstand der Genetik überprüfen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can evaluate the explanatory value of different approaches to evolutionary mechanisms and check their compatibility with current genetic knowledge.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: Initially three light and three dark beetles; later five dark and two light. Bird-on-bark selection context and the explicit generations label show a change in pre-existing variation, not purposeful colour acquisition. The crossed need-directed mutation bubble rejects a misconception. DNA is an orientation symbol, not a molecular structure assessment.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Six initial and seven later separate beetles remain distinguishable at 360 px; the cross and main arrow survive downscaling. Labels are short and recognizable; no mandatory fine-print calculation.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: Does not itself evaluate every historical explanation or document genetic evidence.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Synthetische Evolutionstheorie auf Biodiversität und Artbildung anwenden
wholeGoal.titleEn: Apply Synthetic Evolution Theory to Biodiversity and Speciation
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann die synthetische Evolutionstheorie anwenden, um die Entstehung von Biodiversität und Arten als Zusammenspiel von Evolutionsfaktoren zu erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can apply synthetic evolution theory to explain the emergence of biodiversity and species as an interplay of evolutionary factors.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: Variation/DNA, environmental selection/chance dice and bidirectional gene flow precede geographic isolation. The blocked lower connection and conditional Artbildung möglich avoid claiming that geographic separation alone proves a new species. Colour differences are schematic variation, not a species key.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: The connected upper/lower islands, bidirectional arrow, red block and conditional isolation label are visible at 360 px. Small factor boxes are supporting cues; no necessary tiny prose.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: No actual inheritance experiment, reproductive-isolation test or measured species divergence is pictured.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Synthetische Evolutionstheorie auf Biodiversität und Primaten anwenden
wholeGoal.titleEn: Apply Synthetic Evolution Theory to Biodiversity and Primates
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann die synthetische Evolutionstheorie anwenden, um die Entstehung von Biodiversität und Arten, unter anderem in der Ordnung der Primaten, als Zusammenspiel von Evolutionsfaktoren zu erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can apply synthetic evolution theory to explain the emergence of biodiversity and species, including in primates, as an interplay of evolutionary factors.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: One varied primate population branches into spatially isolated groups with different colour-frequency mixtures. The result is conditional possible speciation, without a modern monkey-to-human ladder. Variation, selection and chance are named; river separation is a geographic schematic.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Large population groups and outward isolation/branching arrows remain visible at 360 px. Friendly generic primates, no taxon-specific anatomical claim or human ranking.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: Isolation does not automatically establish speciation; colours are illustrative, and no real named primate population study is claimed.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Kulturelle Evolution als Selektionsvorteil erklären
wholeGoal.titleEn: Explain Cultural Evolution as a Selection Advantage
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Selektionsvorteile des Menschen aus der vor allem sprachlichen Weitergabe erlernten Verhaltens und Wissens ableiten und damit soziale und kulturelle Evolution sowie die weltweite Verbreitung des Menschen erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can derive human selection advantages from the primarily linguistic transmission of learned behavior and knowledge, explaining social and cultural evolution and worldwide human spread.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: An older person conveys a shelter idea verbally to two younger people; a possible shelter benefit in rain and varied landscapes indicate learned knowledge transmission and environmental occupation. No DNA inheritance or guaranteed reproductive success is asserted.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Speech-bubble shelters, the three age groups, rain shelter and spread arrows remain identifiable at 360 px. Main three labels remain short. No required dates or fine map labels.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: The scene is a generalized learning mechanism, not a dated reconstruction of prehistoric hooded clothing or a measured selection advantage.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Menschliche Umweltanpassung mit natürlicher Selektion vergleichen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Compare Human Environmental Adaptation with Natural Selection
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann beschreiben, wie Menschen ihre Umwelt aktiv an Bedürfnisse anpassen, dies mit natürlicher Selektion als Mechanismus der Entstehung von Angepasstheiten vergleichen und Grenzen sowie Gefahren menschlicher Eingriffe in natürliche Evolutionsprozesse aufzeigen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe how humans actively adapt their environment to their needs, compare this with natural selection as a mechanism for adaptation, and identify limits and risks of human interventions in natural evolutionary processes.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: Deliberate irrigation/cultivation is contrasted with a labelled generational population change under selection. Lower risk panel explicitly says interventions can reduce diversity, a conditional ecological risk rather than a universal prediction. No individual needs-driven evolutionary transformation is shown.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Actor is holding and using a shovel toward the irrigation channel plausibly; no reversed written worksheet. Main cultivating/selection split, generational arrow and diverse-to-less-diverse risk survive 360 px. Small lower prose is redundant with the warning and plant groups.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: This is a qualitative comparison; the two populations are not numerical allele-frequency or genetic-response data.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Verhaltensweisen über Gesamtfitness erklären
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann das Auftreten verschiedener Verhaltensweisen erklären, indem sie deren Einfluss auf die Gesamtfitness des Lebewesens beurteilt.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the occurrence of different behaviors by evaluating their influence on the organism's overall fitness.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: Own offspring and helping related individuals are distinguished and combined with symbolic benefits/costs; the muscle cross separates fitness from physical strength. Dashed relative label supplies the relation needed for the indirect-fitness orientation.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Both feeding nests, the relatives cue, balance and crossed muscle remain visible at 360 px. No quantitative fitness units or formula are required.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: Birds are unnamed schematic agents. This does not establish that depicted co-occurrence or a particular named bird species exhibits experimentally verified cooperative breeding. Coins are a cost metaphor, not measured reproductive output.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Verhaltensökologische Methoden auf Überleben und Fortpflanzung anwenden
wholeGoal.titleEn: Apply Behavioral Ecology Methods to Survival and Reproduction
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Methoden der verhaltensökologischen Forschung anwenden, um Verhaltensweisen zum Überleben des Individuums bei Kooperation, Aggression und Fortpflanzung zu analysieren und deren Bedeutung für die Weitergabe genetischer Information zu erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can apply methods of behavioral ecology to analyze behaviors for individual survival in cooperation, aggression, and reproduction and explain their significance for passing on genetic information.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: Cooperation, aggression and offspring care are distinct schematic behaviours. Observation-to-protocol-to-comparison pipeline separates a method from the later reproduction/DNA orientation. Horizontal and vertical bar order agrees: green greater than yellow greater than blue. Bars have no axes or numeric claims.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Each behaviour and the observation/protocol/comparison icons remains visible at 360 px. The standalone notebook has no represented writer whose page orientation could be reversed. Corrected bar order is visible in both captures.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: The nut scene is a model of joint behaviour, not evidence that simultaneous feeding proves cooperation. Bars are illustrative, not data collected from learners or an actual study.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Verhaltensökologische Methoden auf Kooperation, Kommunikation und Fortpflanzung anwenden
wholeGoal.titleEn: Apply Behavioral Ecology Methods to Cooperation, Communication, and Reproduction
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Methoden der verhaltensökologischen Forschung anwenden, um Verhaltensweisen zum Überleben des Individuums bei Kooperation, Kommunikation, Aggression und Fortpflanzung zu analysieren und deren Bedeutung für die Weitergabe genetischer Information zu erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can apply methods of behavioral ecology to analyze behaviors for individual survival in cooperation, communication, aggression, and reproduction and explain their significance for passing on genetic information.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: Sender emits a signal; receiver reacts away from the background predator, supporting the distinction between communication and response. Cooperation, aggression and offspring care accompany observation/comparison cues. No human-like language or intentional predator negotiation is implied.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Sender/signal/reaction labels, sound waves, predator silhouette, three behaviour panels and observation tools remain clear at 360 px. The notebook is a free-standing research icon without a depicted reader/writer, and contains no required text.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: Orientation only; signalling and response alone do not prove a causal experiment or genetic transmission outcome.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Primaten-Sozialverhalten für menschliches Verhalten kritisch analysieren
wholeGoal.titleEn: Critically Analyze Primate Social Behavior for Human Behavior
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Sozialverhalten von Primaten im Hinblick auf exogene und endogene Ursachen analysieren, um ausgewählte menschliche Verhaltensweisen zu erklären, und einseitig biologistische Erklärungsansätze kritisch zurückweisen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can analyze primate social behavior with regard to exogenous and endogenous causes to explain selected human behaviors and critically reject one-sided biologistic explanations.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: Two converging arrows link internal factors and environment/experience to primate social grooming. The explicit question mark and critically compare connection to human culture/rules avoids a one-to-one innate explanation of human conduct. Generic molecule/shield icons are not claimed as exact structures or quantified mechanisms.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Grooming group, internal/environment panels, question mark and culturally diverse discussion remain recognizable at 360 px. Critical comparison is small but visible and reinforced by the question mark. Friendly SekII orientation with no stereotype ranking.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: No measured hormonal result, deterministic genotype-behaviour relation or normative inference from animals is asserted.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Homo sapiens systematisch einordnen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den modernen Menschen anhand anatomischer und molekularbiologischer Merkmale in das natürliche System einordnen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can classify modern humans in the natural system using anatomical and molecular biological traits.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: The rooted tree places chimpanzee and human as sister branches, with gorilla branching earlier; extant chimpanzees are not human ancestors. Anatomy and DNA cues support evidence-based systematic placement, without invented sequence percentages. Hand is a generic shared anatomical cue, not a detailed phalanx-count worksheet.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: All three taxa, the sister-node topology, root/common-ancestor label and anatomical/DNA cues survive 360 px. No long code, copied layout or evolutionary progress ladder.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: A small illustrative selection of primates, not a complete natural-system taxonomy or DNA alignment.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.

wholeGoal.title: Biologische und kulturelle Evolution des Menschen rekonstruieren
wholeGoal.titleEn: Reconstruct Biological and Cultural Human Evolution
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann aus Merkmalen fossiler Funde Hypothesen zur biologischen Evolution des modernen Menschen ableiten, eine zeitliche Reihenfolge rekonstruieren und die Bedeutung kultureller Evolution für den heutigen Menschen analysieren.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can derive hypotheses about biological human evolution from fossil traits, reconstruct a chronological sequence, and analyze the importance of cultural evolution for humans today.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: Fossil fragments and an older-to-younger axis lead to uncertain branching hypotheses rather than a fixed march-of-progress. Cultural knowledge transmission is separately depicted. The broad biological/cultural overview is consistent as an orientation, while its semantic split remains independently unresolved.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Three labelled panels, fossil fragments, uncertainty dots/question marks and language/tool demonstration remain visible at 360 px. However the foreground open book shows the tool sketches and left-to-right development sequence upright to the outside viewer while the people sit behind its opposite edge. The illustrated entry therefore faces the external viewer, contrary to the required actor perspective.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: Candidate overview for a possibly retained parent only; no approval of atomicity, cultural chronology, source union or split children.
originalAnd360And680Observations.finding: Actor perspective of the open book is reversed.
originalAnd360And680Observations.requiredCorrection: Use a targeted generated correction: orient the actual page illustrations and directional sequence toward the people reading the book, with coherent foreshortening; alternatively remove the open page diagram and retain a clear verbal object demonstration. Keep the scientifically valid fossil and uncertain-tree overview and inspect corrected original/360/680. Do not programmatically rotate or redraw the raster.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope. Actor-page orientation is the specific blocker.

wholeGoal.title: Evo-Devo Perspektiven
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Entwicklungsgenetik (Hox-Gene, Genregulation) für Evolutionsprozesse einordnen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can classify developmental genetics (Hox genes, gene regulation) for evolutionary processes.

images.decisionMeaning: Machine visual/scientific orientation review only; inactive candidate, no human approval or strict closure.

originalAnd360And680Observations.scientific: Hox genes feed spatial and temporal gene regulation, then qualitatively different developmental domains and possible body-pattern variation. Conditional wording avoids claiming that regulation guarantees adaptive change. Coloured domains and generic segmented organisms are model cues, not identified species or a real mutation result.
originalAnd360And680Observations.visual: Hox/DNA, location marker, clock, two coloured domains and two resulting body patterns remain recognizable at 360 px. DNA strands are schematically continuous, not a one-rung gene marker. No unreadable molecular formula or mandatory tiny annotation.
originalAnd360And680Observations.boundaries: The image does not establish homology, selection, a precise gene-expression experiment or literal vertebrate-to-arthropod development.

images.styleAndAgeFit: Friendly clear abstract comic raster; appropriate orientation for the whole goal and its SekI/SekII scope.
